**sdd/issue-196-ci-context-impl/apply-progress**

**What**: Implemented slice A1 (issue #196) of CI context normalization on branch `feat/issue-196-ci-context-impl`. Built `brain/scripts/vcs/ci-context.mjs` (detectCi/loadContext/resolveDetectionBody per REQ-CIC-1..5 + repo field amendment 1 + PR_BODY binary policy amendment 2 + DETECTION two-case rule amendment 3, documented in design.md). Refactored the 5 GitHub context readers (providers/github.mjs prView, governance/run-check.mjs, vcs/actor-check.mjs, vcs/brain-writes-reviewed.mjs, vcs/phase-order-check.mjs) onto `ctx.*` via an injectable `deps.ctx` seam, keeping every existing sync test passing unmodified (deps.X still wins over deps.ctx.X). Added a drift-guard test (no gate reads pipeline env directly except ci-context.mjs) and a REQ-CIC-4 file-assertion proof (pure evaluators evaluateActor/evaluateBrainWritesReviewed/evaluatePhaseOrder/adrPresence/memoryPresence/diffSize/issueLink unchanged). Fixed brain-audit.mjs's prView fail-open-at-source (stopped collapsing prView's null labels/body back to []/''). Added the 3 lockfile globs to brain.config.json governance.ignoreList (ruling 3a). Full TDD: every unit RED before GREEN.
**Why**: Implements the CP-A0-APPROVED contract (openspec/changes/issue-193-ci-context-design) so governance gates stop reading process.env/gh payloads ad hoc and consume one normalized context object regardless of CI provider (ADR-0016, Accepted).
**Where**: brain/scripts/vcs/ci-context.mjs (new), brain/scripts/vcs/ci-context-drift-guard.test.mjs (new), brain/scripts/vcs/providers/github.mjs, brain/scripts/governance/run-check.mjs, brain/scripts/vcs/actor-check.mjs, brain/scripts/vcs/brain-writes-reviewed.mjs, brain/scripts/vcs/phase-order-check.mjs, brain/scripts/brain-audit.mjs, brain.config.json, brain/scripts/lib/governance-ignorelist.test.mjs (new), openspec/changes/issue-196-ci-context-impl/** (proposal/design/spec-delta/tasks/brain-drafts). Counted changed lines (excluding *.test.mjs, openspec/**, .memory/**, lockfiles): 343/400 (149 across 7 modified production files + 194 for the new ci-context.mjs). npm test: 868/868 pass. brain:repo:check: green.
**Learned**: `brain:nav` fails with 4 pre-existing broken relative links in `brain/project/decisions/adr-0016-ci-context-normalization.md` (committed in a prior commit `cd572a3` on this branch, before this apply session started, unrelated to any of my 13 changed files). This is a Tier-2 file (brain/project/**) I must not edit per my task's hard constraints, so I left it and flagged it as a blocker for the orchestrator/human rather than silently fixing or ignoring it. GitLab proxy support in ci-context.mjs's defaultFetchMr is best-effort only — this repo ships zero npm dependencies, so the optional `import('undici')` for ProxyAgent will fail silently and requests proceed unproxied; documented as a structural-only proxy implementation (reads HTTP(S)_PROXY, never hard-codes a host) pending an actual undici dependency if GitLab proxying is needed in practice.
